annotations.title: Record the voice and start the video

description: Creates the video in the person's Fuzzframe account and records the voiceover once (this uses their credits: the brief's Make it is the OK in make it for me; in choose each step, picking the voice is the OK to record; a second take is asked again first). The film is timed on this take, so the script must be final. Returns the video id, every word with its time, and the studio link.

audience.description: Who it is for and what they already know

episode.description: Its episode number in that series (from next_episode), so it's marked made

format.description: The frame's shape: vertical unless the film copies a reference of another shape or they ask for one

look.description: The look's id from the looks tool (their own looks start with my-, from save_look), or a short name for a look described only in this chat

script.description: The voiceover, one paragraph (1 to 3 sentences) per item, exactly as it will be said

series.description: The series this video belongs to, by name, if the person makes it as part of one (made the first time it's named)

voice_name.description: That voice's name, as the voices tool lists it
